item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E001","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Scholz stated that Germany had received more than one million Ukrainian citizens.","notes":["The excerpt supports the reception figure, but not the 14 May 2023 address date or the humanitarian, economic, and military support claim; those appear in other excerpts or metadata."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E002","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Scholz stated that Ukraine could rely on Germany and Europe’s full humanitarian, economic, and military support on a lasting basis, in connection with European values including freedom, democracy, the rule of law, and human rights.","notes":["The excerpt supports the support commitment and values, but does not expressly state support for Ukraine’s path toward EU accession."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E004","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"From 16 October 2023, WEF provided eligibility for families with at least one minor child and taxable annual income up to 90,000 euros plus 10,000 euros for each additional minor child; the page states that over 75 percent of households would thereby be eligible under the estimate attributed to the BMF.","notes":["The excerpt supports the eligibility rules and estimate, but does not expressly characterize them as an expansion."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E010","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Scholz described support for Ukraine’s defense, rule-of-law institutions, reconstruction, and judicial capacity; he referred to establishing a register of damage concerning losses caused by Russia and said that Ukraine would be supported until a just peace was established.","notes":["The excerpt presents the support and register as positions of “we,” including the Council of Europe context; it does not specifically establish that Germany alone endorsed or would implement them."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E011","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E012","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Scholz stated that the Conference of Education Ministers had decided to strengthen the teaching of Jewish history, Israel and the Middle East conflict, and different forms of antisemitism in schools.","notes":["The excerpt supports that the decision occurred in the preceding week, but not the specific December 2023 date."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E013","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E014","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E015","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
